_comment: The interconnected doctrine map. The orchestrator follows the phases; each phase loads its skill, uses its tools, and reaches for cross-cutting data at the right moment. WSTG = the official OWASP testing categories this phase maps to.

phases.goal: record the target + scope (no authorization gate — the disclaimer owns responsibility)
map the full attack surface (JS maps, endpoints, params, config, WAF, ports)
trace source→sink reachability + advanced classes (smuggling, cache, SSRF, SSTI, deserialization)
hunt classes taint misses (POP chains, type juggling, mass assignment, prototype pollution, CRLF, path confusion)
confirm each hypothesis live (marker + negative control + baseline)
deduplicate, review, and emit submission-ready findings

cross_cutting.moment: found a finding — what does it escalate into?
need to run an external exploit tool
need the campaign plan for this target type
map a finding to a standard ID for the report
need domain-specific tools beyond Blitz's own data
